question: Do all four real history19-to-real-target20-23 controls support a useful fixed-requested-geometry observer under the actual approximate input camera model?
scope: already-seen static real fr2_desk photographs, exploratory observer qualification, no generated-image comparison yet, no new neural model
preprocess: Anchor original load_img_and_K then transform_img_and_K576crop in CPU8FP32; verify exact original S68 image tensor SHA, then originalS70 clipping/scaling uint8. Targets unchangedS70referencePNG. SIFT native xy no0.5.
geometry: Optical c2w in meters only, no D or learned normalization. Rji=Rj.T@Ri; tji=Rj.T@(ci-cj); F=inv(Kj).T@skew(tji)@Rji@inv(Ki); divide F by Frobenius norm. Pixel Ks=Kt=cached K_pixels_576. No estimated F/H/pose or retuned calibration.
matching: BF L2 knn2 both directions strict ratio<.75 and mutual identities; keep all sorted matches; no RANSAC or geometric filtering
residual: a=abs(xj.T F xi); d_to_target=a/norm((Fxi)[:2]); d_to_source=a/norm((F.T xj)[:2]); mean_symmetric_px=(d_to_target+d_to_source)/2. Not squared Sampson.
report: All per-match xy and residuals, q25/50/75/95, descriptive fractions <=2/5/10px, source/destination xy span and4x4 occupied cells. No matched subset selection or automatic camera-correct verdict. Few points weak even when residual finite.
independent_review: Different-author source review before execution; independent scalar arithmetic/geometry from saved coordinates and accepted cameras after. Not independent correspondence truth.
limits: Approximate ROS K/no undistortion, interpolated GT camera, real-image feature mismatches or dynamic objects can cause residual. Fixed F is necessary not sufficient; low error does not prove pose/depth correctness. fr1 discussion in S71 not applicable; actual sequence fr2_desk.
revision_reason: Pre-run different-author review found cv2uint8 area not identical to original TorchFP32 area; preserve v1 unexecuted and use exact original helper path.
